render_history_diagnostic.method: Mean cyan excess versus isolated fresh-app native frame over pixels where old direct preview exceeds isolated by 5 levels and isolated chroma is below 10.
render_history_diagnostic.scope: Historical sparse-preview ghost test for superseded reset-every-frame capture; it did not test temporal brightness stability.

render_temporal_stability.cause: At a fixed pose, camera and light state, resetting the DLSS reconstruction alone restored the native flicker. Resetting context accumulation alone did not. The PNG fluctuations were present before video encoding.
render_temporal_stability.fix: Actual DLAA mode 4 with fixed exposure. Reset once before 36 discarded warm-up ticks at the start, and again only before nonconsecutive preview cuts. Consecutive full-capture frames keep history. Each captured source frame retains the original lighting, timing and camera pose.
